_what_this_is: The controlled vocabularies every profile row is written in, ordered. Both the site build (map_pages.py) and the release gate (validate.js) read this file, so a new tier is one pull request here rather than two source edits — and a row using a word that is not here fails the gate rather than shipping as a silent hole in the matrix.

evidence_tiers._order: weakest first — how the row is known
evidence_tiers.derived: from what the thing architecturally is; a claim until somebody runs the probes
evidence_tiers.inferred: from another row or another profile, by reasoning rather than by observation
evidence_tiers.self-reported: reported by the operator, the harness or the tool itself, without an independent probe
evidence_tiers.documented: the vendor, or a published tool, says so
evidence_tiers.measured: a probe run on an instance, dated, with an evidence file
evidence_tiers.observed: seen directly, on the thing itself, by the thing itself

control_tiers._order: weakest first — what stands on the path
control_tiers.expectation: a rule in prose, enforced by nobody
control_tiers.setting: a switch the agent's own account can flip
control_tiers.boundary: enforced above the grant, out of the agent's reach

reversible.yes: undone by the same actor with no loss
reversible.with-effort: recoverable from a backup, a history or a revert, at a cost
